summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for tag collection normalization in the initialization stage. It does not semantically match any existing skill (which cover reward transforms, async exception inspection, and observability/client patterns). Peer candidates are initialization-stage skills but operate on different domains (observability, client lifecycle, agent setup) with no overlap in capability. The candidate addresses a specific data preparation concern (tag deduplication and null-handling) that is orthogonal to existing skills.
